verdict.rationale: Webhooks deliver real-time notifications when specific events occur (docs-9), and transaction notifications are listed (docs-20). OBWMS is described in future tense ('will provide') as an API for subscribing to specific events (docs-26). This gives an event source, but any rule logic or automatic action must be built by the developer in their own system. Missing for 10: a native rule-definition or condition engine, built-in automatic actions triggered by events, OBWMS subscription filtering documented as actually shipped, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
